jsonFormat.expectedValue: Message from the JSON formatter. The messages in this file describe a mistake in JSON typed by the user; they are shown in the body editor.
jsonFormat.unexpected: {{character}} is the character that was found, in quotes, or the words that end of text stands for.
jsonFormat.endOfText: Inserted after Unexpected when the text ends where something was expected.
jsonFormat.expectedColon: Keep the quoted colon as given.
jsonFormat.expectedObjectEnd: Keep the quoted comma and brace as given.
jsonFormat.expectedArrayEnd: Keep the quoted comma and bracket as given.
jsonFormat.trailingComma: {{closer}} is the closing brace or bracket.
jsonFormat.lineBreakInString: Keep \n as given: it is the escape sequence for a line break.
jsonFormat.unclosedReference: {{reference}} is the variable syntax of Gostman with the word variable inside double braces; {{closer}} is the closing double brace. Keep both as given.
